name: IGB Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Launched on July 25, 2012, IGB REIT operates as a Malaysian real estate investment trust. It debuted on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad on September 21, 2012, holding a portfolio of revenue-generating retail properties. Its holdings consist of two prominent shopping centers, Mid Valley Megamall (MVM) and The Gardens Mall (TGM), both situated within the Klang Valley region. These properties collectively offer approximately 2.70 million square feet of net lettable area. As of December 31, 2022, the trust's market capitalization stood at RM5.92 billion, with its investment properties independently assessed at RM5.02 billion. IGB Berhad serves as the primary unitholder, possessing a 48.332% stake as of the same date.
